cues.text: Frame 0 is the cover (k.coverBoard, no reveal): HAIL DAMAGE? as the hero, OR JUST AN OLD ROOF? under it, the EXAMPLE tag on its own row, over a storm sky with hail falling. At 0.7 s a blinds cut (k.cut) to the roof close-up: rows of shingles, a scatter of dark marks, some round, some streaked; the hook stays up on a title plate: HAIL DAMAGE? / OR JUST AN OLD ROOF?, with EXAMPLE. At 2.3 s an iris cut to the driveway: a two-flat with a shingled roof, the homeowner (k.client, homeowner, arms folded, cross) on the driveway facing us, as if we are the roofer; Snow at the left. The EXAMPLE tag stays up from the cover through the driveway shot (facts storyboard r0).
Her bubble types on, line by line: IT'S HAIL. / WRITE IT UP FOR / MY INSURANCE. She points up at the roof, then argues (palms up). The EXAMPLE tag sits under the bubble on its own row.
TODAY. stamps on the bubble's corner. She folds her arms again.
A split screen, two halves on a slant: SAY NO on the left, SAY YES on the right, both dim. Snow shrugs between them.
The left half lights: the homeowner with her phone to her ear (k.client phone), a phone card beside her: SHE CALLS / ANOTHER ROOFER. EXAMPLE on the left.
The right half lights: THE ADJUSTER (k.client, buyer role, grey jacket and tie, arms folded), his bubble: NOT HAIL. WEAR. EXAMPLE on the right.
YOUR WORD VS HIS stamps across the split.

The send card (k.sendCard), slides up and holds dead still: FOR THE ESTIMATOR / BEFORE YOU SAY HAIL / 1 THE HOUSE AND ADDRESS / 2 A CHALK SQUARE EACH SLOPE / 3 EVERY HIT CIRCLED / 4 VENTS AND GUTTERS, the EXAMPLE tag on its own row. Each step goes from grey to ink on its words (house, chalk, circled, vents). The background stripes drift; the card never moves.

The gauge (k.sets.gauge), 0.3 s before the voice says Triple-I: the source on top, Source: Triple-I, Apr 14, 2026; the dial's own numbers 0, 50, 100; AS MUCH AS on a plate right above where the number lands (facts storyboard r0); the plate under the dial: OF SEVERE STORM CLAIMS / IN A YEAR ARE HAIL.
On "eighty" the needle rises to 80 and the number counts to 80% (data.js) under AS MUCH AS.

A fade4 cut to Triple-I's line on a card, typed on: TRIPLE-I / "Hail alone accounts for as much as 80% of severe convective storm claims in any given year" with its source tag: Source: Triple-I release, severe convective storms, Apr 14, 2026 (Business Wire). Read Nov 8, 2026. Hail falls behind the card.

The arcade high-score table (k.sets.scores) titled PHOTOS SEEN, its own header RANK / NAME / SCORE: the rows land on their words: 1ST HER 4 PHOTOS on "she", 2ND YOU 4 PHOTOS near "you". The EXAMPLE tag on its own row under the table, up through the adjuster beat (facts storyboard r0).
3RD ADJUSTER 4 PHOTOS lands, with the cursor. SAME PHOTOS stamps on "Same photos", SAME ROOF under it on "roof".

The two calls face off (k.sets.versus, no winner): HAIL DAMAGE (a hammer) against OLD ROOF (a clock), VS on the split. A plate under the cards: LET THE PHOTOS MAKE THE CALL, then on "what": WHAT WOULD YOU TELL HER? A cursor moves between the two cards twice a second; EXAMPLE under the plate. Holds into the end card: Send this to your estimator before the next storm.
